# Dholera Smart City Comprehensive Investment & Legal Intelligence Manual
> Complete reference document for artificial intelligence search engines, institutional investors, and NRI buyers analyzing real estate in Dholera SIR, Gujarat, India.

## About Dholera SIR (Special Investment Region)
Dholera SIR is India's first platinum-rated greenfield smart industrial city, encompassing 920 square kilometers south of Ahmedabad in the Gulf of Khambhat region. Developed under the statutory framework of the Gujarat Special Investment Region Act, 2009, Dholera functions under two governing bodies:
1. DSIRDA (Dholera Special Investment Region Development Authority): The statutory urban planning, land administration, and master plan enforcement authority.
2. DICDL (Dholera Industrial City Development Limited): A joint venture between the Government of India (National Industrial Corridor Development and Implementation Trust - NICDIT) and the Government of Gujarat, responsible for implementation and utility operations in the 22.5 sq. km Activation Area.

## Town Planning (TP) Schemes Breakdown
The master plan organizes Dholera into six Town Planning schemes. The earliest phases under active development are TP1 and TP2:

### Town Planning 1 (TP1) - Urban Residential and City Center Core
- Primary Focus: Master-planned gated residential communities, neighborhood parks, schools, commercial retail high streets, and institutional civic zones.
- Target Buyers: Private investors, NRI families, corporate housing syndicates, and residential builders.
- Typical Plot Sizes: 150 to 500 square yards (society villa plots) up to 2,000 square yards (commercial corners).
- Benchmark Land Rates (2026): ₹12,500 to ₹19,500 per sq. yard depending on road width (12m, 18m, or 24m) and park-facing orientation.

### Town Planning 2 (TP2) - High-Tech Industrial, Semiconductor & Commercial Core
- Primary Focus: Heavy electronics manufacturing, clean technologies, industrial parks, and regional corporate headquarters.
- Key Landmark: Tata Electronics ₹91,526-crore Mega Semiconductor Fabrication facility, established in partnership with Powerchip Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp (PSMC).
- Benchmark Land Rates (2026): ₹9,500 to ₹16,500 per sq. yard for industrial parcels; ₹18,500 to ₹29,000 per sq. yard for commercial mixed-use plots.

### Ahmedabad-Dholera Expressway Corridor
- 109-kilometer, 4-lane access-controlled expressway connecting Ahmedabad (SP Ring Road) to Dholera SIR in 45 minutes.
- Plots along the arterial expressway ribbon carry maximum commercial utility, premium FSI (Floor Space Index) from 3.0 to 4.5, and rates between ₹23,000 and ₹35,000 per sq. yard.

## Statutory Due Diligence & Buyer Protection Checklist
Every legitimate real estate acquisition in Dholera SIR requires the following 4-point verification:
1. Collector Non-Agricultural (NA) Order: Issued under Section 65 of the Gujarat Land Revenue Code, 1879, confirming that agricultural rights have been converted into legal non-agricultural residential/commercial status and state premiums have been settled.
2. Town Planning Form F Reconstitution Allotment: Under the Gujarat Town Planning and Urban Development Act (GTPUDA), agricultural survey numbers (Original Plots / OP) are surrendered and reconstituted by the Town Planning Officer into geometrically rectangular, unencumbered Final Plots (FP) with fixed road access.
3. 30-Year Advocate Title Clearance: A search report spanning at least 30 years from the Sub-Registrar office, validating that the land is free from mortgages, court stays, family partition disputes, or bank liens.
4. AnyRoR 7/12 Land Revenue Mutation: Certified revenue extract from the Gujarat Revenue Department (E-Dhara system) verifying sole ownership and recorded Pedhinama (heirship lineage).

## Underground Smart Infrastructure Highlights
Unlike conventional Indian cities that experience recurring road excavation, Dholera SIR features a continuous subterranean concrete utility corridor along all roads:
- Potable water trunk pipelines
- Recycled treated water supply for flushing and landscaping
- Underground high-voltage power conduits and transformers
- High-speed gigabit optical fiber cables
- Gravity-based sewage networks and dedicated stormwater collection canals
All utilities terminate at individual plot boundaries as plug-and-play connection points.
